title: Higher-layer shadow uniqueness grammar
scope: Compute low-energy shadows after scalar breaking and test stable-composite plus mass closure with a clean-shadow condition rejecting confining-charged broken-vector exotics.
audit: run_step38.py validates Step-35 survivor reproduction, base shadow survival, clean shadow survivor counts, detector flags for rejected diagnostics, source paths, and no-overclaim boundaries.
note: The base shadow admits the small family; the clean shadow selects the 2|3 structure family because the single-factor family has computed broken-vector exotics.
non_triviality_argument: The clean shadow is computed from the low-energy subgroup and broken-generator content of each candidate; single-factor rows are evaluated and fail for a derived low-energy reason, not by construction.
excluded_designs_rationale: Excluded designs: fixed factor-count requirements, slot-count locks, larger-group recognition priors, parent-descent tests, exterior-only ansatz, empirical content insertion, target-shape primitives, size/currency orderings, and row-pickers.
constraint_transfer: Gstress to Gshadow: reject prior uniqueness rescues, compute low-energy shadows, and use clean stable-composite plus mass as the higher-layer shadow criterion.
